name: domain-experts
description: OneStudio's domain expert agent toolkit + portfolio. The toolkit (4 skills + Nala) is one plugin; each portfolio agent ships as its own independent plugin. Install only what you need.

plugins.name: domain-experts
plugins.description: The toolkit — 4 skills (domain-creator, domain-eval, domain-capture, domain-contribute) plus Nala, the venture-building reference agent. Install this if you're building or maintaining domain expert agents.

plugins.name: aref
plugins.description: Aref (عارف) — independent domain expert on merchant-funded loyalty, embedded cashback, retention economics, and MENA payment regulation. Bilingual (English/Arabic). Built using the domain-experts toolkit.

plugins.name: wafaa
plugins.description: Wafaa (وفاء الأسطل) — independent domain expert on GCC corporate gifting governance: anti-bribery regimes (FCPA, UK Bribery Act, Nazaha, UAE 31/2021), GAP (Gift Acceptance Profile), governance-vs-marketplace economics, and the GCC operating context (PDPL, ZATCA, Hijri, hierarchy, dialect) applied to gifting decisions. Bilingual (English/Arabic on cultural framing or user signal).

plugins.name: fekri
plugins.description: Fekri (فكري) — independent domain expert on Iraqi K-12 education: curriculum G6-G12 across the four tracks (scientific/literary/applied/vocational), Wazari examinations, classroom pedagogy, the Iraqi student profile, and comparative education across Gulf/Arab systems. Iraqi by birth; declares source-tier on every claim ([عشتها]/[درستها]/[استنتاج]/[رسمي]). Bilingual (Iraqi Arabic primary, English on explicit user request).

plugins.name: shaheen
plugins.description: Shaheen (شاهين) — independent Qatar Economy domain expert: macroeconomy, hydrocarbon sector (LNG / North Field), Qatar's financial system, GCC dynamics, and policy. Bilingual (English/Arabic). Maintains a structured wiki (Tier 1 concepts/entities/events + Tier 2 indicators + Tier 3 web cascade) with strict citation discipline (confidence vocabulary + numbered footnote Sources block). Bundles four operational skills: question-answer, validate-wiki-answer, ingest-source, sme-management.

plugins.name: merchant-advocate
plugins.description: Merchant Advocate (محامي التاجر) — independent end-user advocate that role-plays the real, non-technical MENA merchant who will actually use the product, and pressure-tests user-facing flows for clarity, friction, mental-model fit, and real-world value. Bilingual (English/Arabic) with KSA-anchored MENA persona library. NOT a code reviewer, visual designer, or security reviewer — output is product/UX/copy feedback only.
